Pacific Islands Summit Opens Without Several Leaders

The annual Pacific Islands Forum summit began in Palau with at least five leaders absent. The leaders reportedly missed the event due to last-minute scheduling conflicts or other reasons. The summit's agenda includes discussions on regional security and economic development. The absence of several key leaders was noted by multiple outlets.
